_meta.purpose: User-visible text for the Lunar Lander rebuild (Task 0.4b). Local working artifact, not committed.

provenance_values.recovered: Exact text compiled into lunar-lander.swf, extracted with FFDec `-export text` (work/phet-verify/lunar-lander-text/<chid>.txt). Not written by us.
provenance_values.supplied: Original English text written for Reanimator because the SWF never supplied a usable value for this slot. Not copied from any PhET translation file - PhET's translation XML for this sim was never obtained (see behavior-spec.md, section 5b).

softLandingsColon.note: FFDec export includes trailing   padding before the live count; trimmed here to a plain label, padding is a layout detail for the rebuild to decide.

hitBoulder.value:
Hit boulder!  
Leg damaged.
Fuel lost.
hitBoulder.note: FIXED after a correction request: the raw FFDec export uses a lone CR (0x0D, classic Mac-style line break) between lines, which an earlier pass silently lost by joining with spaces. Re-read directly from the raw bytes; this is the real 3-line structure, not a guess.

helpButtonLabelDefault.note: This is the button's own compiled fallback label, not the resolved value of the 'help' simStrings key. The 'help' key is looked up (Internationalizer.as) but the result is discarded by a second, button-local guard (DefineSprite_23_helpButton/frame_1/DoAction.as) because the lookup fails. This is the text actually shown on screen.

unpauseButtonLabelDefault.note: Same situation as helpButtonLabelDefault, for the 'unpause' simStrings key.

introPlaqueRulesShort.value:
How many flat zones can you touch before fuel is out?
Extra points for soft landings ( v < 2 m/s).
Game over if you hit a boulder or crashland ( v > 6 m/s).
introPlaqueRulesShort.note: FIXED after a correction request: the raw FFDec export uses a lone CR (0x0D) between these 3 sentences, which an earlier pass lost entirely (joined with zero separator, producing 'out?Extra'). Re-read directly from the raw bytes. Which specific label1-label7 key this corresponds to is still not confirmed - FFDec's plain-text export is keyed by character ID, not field name - but the line content and structure themselves are now exact.

introPlaqueLegend_tiltRight.note: FIXED: raw export has a lone-CR break between 'Tilt' and 'Right' (two lines in the original narrow legend column), not one word 'TiltRight'.

introPlaqueLegend_tiltLeft.note: FIXED: same as introPlaqueLegend_tiltRight, 'Tilt' / 'Left' on two lines.

introPlaqueLegend_moreThrust.note: Leading/trailing padding spaces in the compiled text (likely a layout hack) trimmed here.

helpPlaqueLongHelp.value:
~ Land in as many different flat zones as you can before your fuel runs out.
~ After landing, take off by increasing thrust.
~ No credit for landing in the same zone more than once.
~ More points for landing in smaller or harder-to-reach zones:  
     Easy big zones = 5 points   to    Killer tight zones = 50 points
~ 10 extra points for a soft landing ( v < 2 m/s).
~ Game over if you touch a boulder. (You can't land on boulders!)
~ Game over if you crash land (v > 12 m/s).
helpPlaqueLongHelp.note: FIXED after a correction request: this is a genuine bulleted list - lines are separated by a lone CR (0x0D) in the raw export, and each bullet line starts with a literal '~' character (used as a bullet glyph in the original font, not a line-break marker as an earlier pass assumed). An earlier pass removed the '~' and joined everything into run-on prose, losing the list structure and the 'out of reach'/point-value formatting line. Re-read directly from the raw bytes and kept verbatim, including the '~' bullets and the indented point-value line. Key name 'longHelp' is confirmed to exist in Internationalizer.as and this is the only long-paragraph field on the help plaque, so this pairing is high- but not 100%-confidence.

helpPlaqueKeyboardControlsHeader.note: FIXED: 'Keyboard' / 'Controls:' are on two separate lines in the raw export (lone CR), not one line 'Keyboard Controls:'.

helpPlaqueLegend_reset.note: Distinct compiled text block from the Reset BUTTON's own label (key 'reset', chid 24) - this is a word next to the 'R' key-legend entry on the help plaque.

helpPlaqueLegend_tiltRight.note: FIXED: lone-CR break, 'Tilt' / 'Right' on two lines - see introPlaqueLegend_tiltRight.

helpPlaqueLegend_tiltLeft.note: FIXED: lone-CR break, 'Tilt' / 'Left' on two lines.

landingSpeedEq.note: Missing from the SWF: Internationalizer.as assigns this key's lookup result straight to _root.landingSpeed_str with no fallback guard, so at runtime it is literally the string "keyNotFound". Confirmed with FFDec that the consuming field (landingSpeedReport_mc.message1_txt) has no compiled default text either. Written fresh for Reanimator; concatenated in code as `landingSpeedEq + <number> + " m/s"`, so this value intentionally ends with a space and no trailing punctuation.

softLanding.note: Missing from the SWF for the same reason as landingSpeedEq. Shown alone in landingSpeedReport_mc.message2_txt when crashState == "softLanded".

hardLanding.note: Missing from the SWF. Shown alone in message2_txt when crashState == "hardLanded".

crash1.value: Crash landing! The legs are damaged.
crash1.note: Missing from the SWF. Shown in message2_txt for a non-fatal crash landing (landingSpeed <= damageLandingSpeed).

crash2.value: Crash landing! The lander was destroyed.
crash2.note: Missing from the SWF. Shown in message2_txt for a fatal crash landing (landingSpeed > damageLandingSpeed).
